name: Master Bedroom Closet
notes: Measured: A 71, B 21.5, C 38, D 38, E 38 (to the far side of the shelf nook), nook depth 15, door frame to back wall 152, hallway 40, widest 56, ceiling 101, 28" doorway with a 9" return on its left. Derived: B's angle (48.1°, from the 16" bump-out 56 − 40), D at 45° (the only angle that lands the walk on the 152" depth), nook width 8.9" (38" back wall minus the window span to the clothes-wall line), the 3" return right of the doorway (40 − 9 − 28), and F = 152 − 15. Assumed square: the nook's side wall. Doorway on wall G (offset 3, 28" wide) is an opening only — the door swings out into the bedroom and is drawn on the bedroom's wall E.
